video.title: AI is STEALING These Jobs! Here's How to Profit

summary: Chris Koerner argues that AI exposes a large share of US jobs (claims 25% fully performable, 70% exposed) and pitches business ideas for workers in healthcare, retail and professional services. Ideas range from licensed clinical businesses (IV therapy, mobile Botox, GLP-1 services) to product sourcing, reselling, dashboards, buying accounting practices, fractional CFO agencies and AI implementation. He is most excited about AI implementation for SMBs and promotes his own community Playmakers AI. Most content is listicle-style with rough numbers and little process detail.

speakers.description: Host of The Koerner Office; ex-importer of iPhone screens; runs Playmakers AI community

ideas.offer: IV hydration and vitamin therapy sessions

acquisition_channels.details: Google Trends cited; no acquisition method stated

ideas.delivery: Coach/consultant delivers sessions, can be remote

delivery.how: Human-led consulting, AI could assist with plans

ideas.name: Mobile Botox / Botox parties

ideas.delivery: Licensed injector performs treatments in person

ideas.name: GLP-1 / semaglutide adjacent businesses
ideas.one_liner: Apps, coaching and services piggybacking on GLP-1 weight-loss drugs.

quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: Product sourcing agency

ideas.problem: Finding quality suppliers at best prices

pricing.model: fee plus percentage of product spend
pricing.notes: Host paid 3% to a sourcing agent

ideas.delivery: Use Import Yeti shipment data to identify manufacturers, then manage sourcing and quality

acquisition.how: Cold email to limited companies is legal; relationship-led

delivery.how: Research can be automated; supplier negotiation/QC needs humans

uk_applicability.notes: Import records (US bill of lading) are US-specific, but UK brands can use Alibaba and other data; works with changes.

quotes.text: I found a guy on Alibaba named Brian, and Brian took 3% of every dollar I sent to China
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: Reselling on Facebook Marketplace

ideas.offer: Resold goods, including from liquidation sites

uk_applicability.notes: Facebook Marketplace is available in UK; B-Stock and GovDeals are mostly US-focused, UK alternatives exist.

ideas.name: Buy accounting/bookkeeping practices and augment with AI

ideas.business_model: service firm revenue with AI-boosted margins

warnings.warning: Clinical businesses (Botox, GLP-1) require licences such as NP, PA or MD, training, inventory and malpractice insurance.

quote.text: You've got to be licensed, you need injector training, you've got to buy inventory up front
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Displaced workers can pivot into adjacent businesses where AI is a tool rather than a threat.
Use Google Trends as a quick demand check for ideas like IV therapy and fractional services.

quote.text: Look what the Google Trends data shows for fractional services.
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Listing before buying inventory tests demand without capital risk.
Recurring retainers (dashboards, fractional services, AI implementation) beat one-off fees for revenue stability.
Selling AI implementation to SMBs works because owners know they need AI but lack skills; the tools are easy.

quote.text: They know that they need to implement AI in their businesses.
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: A percentage-of-spend model aligns the agent with client outcomes, as with the 3% sourcing agent.
Licensed healthcare ideas need a licensed person; non-licensed founders should look at tangential plays such as apps or coaching.

evidence_quality.rationale: Listicle-style roundup with unsourced figures, no operator case studies beyond a brief importing anecdote; numbers are generic ranges and partly garbled in the transcript.
evidence_quality.promotional_conflict: Host runs the Playmakers AI paid community for AI automation/implementation businesses and promotes the AI implementation idea most strongly; also asks viewers to subscribe.
